confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Accommodation is less certain because July is peak season and star tiers vary locally. Cocktail and wine were derived from the beer anchor at about 2.5x and 2.3x because direct price knowledge is weak. Rupiah price points were converted at roughly 16,800 IDR per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional SEA basis treating Canggu as a Bali tourist hub, with Seminyak as the closest comparable in price tier and demand. No external price source was used for the anchors.
